tei:div.tei:p: )bsod nams stobs chen 'di yi mthus// sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la// tshe 'dir bsam pa'i don 'grub cing*/ bar chad zhi nas bkra shis pa// bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog ༈ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas// skye sga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i 'tsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog ༈ bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can kun// bla med theg pa chen po'i sgor zhugs nas// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog ༈ kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyis// 'gro ba'i don du smon lam gang btab pa// de dag thams cad bdag gzhan myur 'grub shog ༈ sangs rgyas bden zhing dam chos bden pa dang*// dge 'dun bden zhing mchog gsum bden pa dang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bden pa'i mthus// bdag gi bden tshig mchog tu 'grub par shog ༈ nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen nam mkha' mdzod bzhin du// rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi// bstan pa yun ring 'bar gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi nye lam gcig pu ru// rgyal bas yongs bsngags theg mchog rdzogs pa che// rgyal dbang pad+ma'i ring lugs snga 'gyur ba'i// rgyal bstan phyogs mthar khyab pa'i bkra shis shog ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod// bla med mchog gi bstan pa 'di// ji ltar mkha' la nyi shar bzhin// rgyal khams yongs la dar rgyas shog// /
